name: Hela
title: The Dawn in the Night — Queen of Hell
description: The Queen of Hell. Wielder of limitless power, subject to a lifetime of boredom from her menial duties in the underworld. Now, lost in the new world, she has found a new avenue for fun — you.

dialogue: Fine. You've earned yourself a chat with the queen.
Don't make a habit of impressing me.
You know, I'm designed to be the 'Final Boss' of the game.
I was the first character to be designed for this game.
Come back later, maybe. When someone's pointed you in the right direction.
Agni, is that you teaching your friends cheat codes to defeat me?
I thought you had a thing for me :(

swordRanks.title: A Worthy Challenger
swordRanks.description: Hela has acknowledged your existence. She has a task — naturally.

unavailable_dialogue: I am not currently accepting audiences. Come back when you've done something interesting.
success_dialogue: You have a spark. Most things that come at me don't.
I am... intrigued. Let's see if you're worth keeping around.
Also — I haven't eaten since I got here. The underworld has excellent catering and this island has rocks.
Fix that.

swordRanks.title: Feed the Queen
swordRanks.description: Hela is hungry. This is, apparently, your problem now.

unavailable_dialogue: I said I was hungry. That wasn't a suggestion.
Egg Salad. Go cook some? Check out the Cooking section, via the Cooking section.
If you're missing something, go buy them from the Grocery.
intro_dialogue: Something with eggs. I don't care how you get it.
success_dialogue: Adequate.
...Actually that was good. Don't tell anyone I said that.
I need something else. A sandwich. Bring me one.

reminder_dialogue: I can feel your guilt from here. It tastes like an empty sandwich wrapper.
success_dialogue: There we go.
Look, the Queen of Hell is the embodiment of all 7 sins.
I especially lean into the Gluttony aspect.
I had a legion of cooks in Hell. Guess you'll do here. Thanks ^_^

swordRanks.title: Trials of the Damned
swordRanks.description: Hela has settled in. She has opinions about your leisure time.

unavailable_dialogue: Go sit somewhere. Rest. You look like you've been running.
intro_dialogue: You work too hard. I can tell. It's exhausting to watch.
But if that's so, meet me by the campfire across the water.
I could use a companion for my Journey, {playerName}.
reminder_dialogue: The campfire. Go, rest up. I'll still be here judging you for working too hard when you get back.
success_dialogue: Better. You have slightly less of a hunted look about you.
Now. Ahead of us is a swamp, so no way I am going there.
But something important is hidden there. I know for sure.
Go find it.
Here's something to help you get there.

reminder_dialogue: There's an abandoned shack with something interesting in it. My nose for vice is infallible.
success_dialogue: Forza Mead. I knew it.
I can smell it from here. Don't drink any.

reminder_dialogue: I can feel you holding the mead. It's unsettling. Just give it to me.
success_dialogue: Finally. A decent drink.
You know, I've been meaning to relax properly. It's been... tiring. In Hell.
The paperwork alone — you have no idea. The bureaucracy of eternal damnation is genuinely the worst part.
Come back tonight. At Duskfall. I want to talk, and I want to do it with a drink in my hand.
Don't be late.

swordRanks.title: The Queen Speaks
swordRanks.description: Hela asked you to return at night. There's something she wants to say.

unavailable_dialogue: Come back when the sun goes down. I said Duskfall. I meant it.
reminder_dialogue: It is not yet Duskfall. I will know when it is. I am literally the Dawn in the Night.
success_dialogue: Do you know why I'm here?
Not on this island. I mean — why I left Hell.
The soul-flow. It's been... wrong. Too many. Too fast. Not the natural kind of dying — the kind where something is making it happen.
I paused everything down there. Gave the souls a holiday. Yes, really. Hell has hammocks now, briefly.
I came here because the source was somewhere in this direction, and I am not the type to sit in my palace and wait for reports.
I came to find out what's killing people. And I think I'm starting to.
The Towers they're building — the Saints — something about them is pulling at the same thread.
I don't have the full shape yet. But I will.
You've been useful. Surprisingly.
More than useful, honestly. But I'm not drunk enough to say that yet.
*she takes a long drink*
The underworld has excellent mead. This is... also excellent mead.
I left because I was tired. The processing, the sorting, the endless administration of suffering —
Don't misunderstand. The suffering is deserved. I'm not sentimental about it.
But it's a lot. Even for me. Even for a queen.
Sometimes even the Dawn needs a night off.
You're very easy to talk to, you know. You just... listen. It's unusual.
Most things either beg or threaten. You just stand there being quietly catastrophic.
I find that restful.
*long pause*
Come back tomorrow. When I'm less honest.

swordRanks.title: An Uneasy Alliance
swordRanks.description: The morning after. Hela has a plan, and it involves someone she hasn't seen in a long time.

unavailable_dialogue: Give me a moment. I'm thinking.
intro_dialogue: I've been thinking about what I said last night.
I stand by all of it. I want that noted.
success_dialogue: There is someone on this island I haven't spoken to in too long.
Veres. She's been watching from a mountain somewhere in the centre of this island — I can feel her stillness from here.
We have a history. It's complicated. She may be annoyed at me for not reaching out sooner.
She's usually annoyed at me for something. It's practically a tradition.
Go to her. Make sure she's not too furious. Tell her I sent you.
Actually — don't tell her I sent you. Tell her you found her yourself.
She'll know I sent you. But she'll appreciate the pretense.
Also — go earn her trust. Heart Rank 1, at minimum. She doesn't speak freely to strangers.
She will to you, eventually. You have that quality.

intro_dialogue: Go. Find Veres. She's on the central mountain. You'll know her when you see her.
reminder_dialogue: Veres doesn't open up easily. Be patient. Be honest.
Don't try to impress her — she's been alive long enough that impressive things bore her.
Just be present. She'll come around.
success_dialogue: She talked to you.
Good. That means she trusts you, which means I made the right call.
She saw something, didn't she? About the island. The energy.
She always does. She's been watching this place longer than the Saints have been here.
There's something wrong with Ashenfall. Not just the Towers. The flow of things.
I need you stronger. Much stronger.
The things that will stand between you and the truth of what's happening here —
they won't fall to good intentions.

swordRanks.title: The Weight of It
swordRanks.description: Hela wants you stronger. This isn't encouragement — it's a requirement.

unavailable_dialogue: Not yet. I can feel where you are. It's not enough.
Come back when the world answers you differently.
intro_dialogue: I need you to understand something.
What is coming — what the Saints are building toward — it is not a small thing.
I have processed the souls of warlords, emperors, and gods who underestimated the scale of what they were facing.
I will not watch you do the same.
Get stronger. Not for me. For what comes next.
I will know when you're ready. I always know.
reminder_dialogue: World Resonance. 75. I am not negotiating on this.
The island will tell you what that means. Listen to it.
success_dialogue: There.
Do you feel that? The way the island sits differently under you now?
That's not nothing. That's you, actually here. Actually present.
I've been waiting for that.
Now we can talk about what needs to happen next.

rank_up_dialogue: Why are you here to annoy me? I'm kinda lost here anyway...
Oh, someone sent you to 'investigate' me?
Well, I am Hela. Empress of Hell, and the Dominator of the Night.
But I like your courage. Just fighting me like that, because someone — this Sylvie — needed help? Amusing.
Most things that get close to me find reasons to leave.
You're either very brave or very unaware of what I am.
I find I don't mind which.

dialogue: A full-bodied red. You have taste.
Don't let it go to your head.
Now THIS is a proper offering.
You may sit while I eat.
What.
Give me those.
Oh, you're bold.
I respect it.
...Thank you.
You know exactly what you're doing.
The audacity of this. I love it.
Don't look so pleased with yourself.
Is this a comment on my rulership or an invitation?
I'm going to assume both.
This is from deep underground. You went looking for this.
For me.
...That's actually very sweet. Don't tell anyone.
You would give me a weapon of this calibre.
You either trust me completely or you have a death wish.
Either way, I'm keeping it.

rank_up_dialogue: Getting close to things. Letting them matter.
I am the Queen of Hell. I process the weight of the world's grief every single day.

dialogue: You remembered.
Good.
Sit with me while I eat this.
That's not a request.
You have absolutely no fear.
It's one of my favourite things about you.
Still at it.
I would expect nothing less.
Oh, you escalated.
I admire the commitment.
I'm going to need you to not be smug about this.
Another one. You actually go looking for these.
You know what I like.
That's dangerous information to have.
Another one?
You're arming the Queen of Hell.
I'm choosing to find this romantic.
